summary: Complete implementation plan and summary of enhancements for Spider Grid Solutions CRM: HSN codes, Admin Dashboard with prefill customization, Golden Customer search & autocomplete on Job Cards, payment modes with UPI/UTR references, clickable bill detail modal with physical receipt photo preview, live profit & loss calculations with manual cost adjustment, bill actions (edit, duplicate, cancel), phone call completion logging, and customizable WhatsApp message templates with Google Review link.
